agentEmail.introTitle: Give your agent an email address
agentEmail.introBody: Some sites ask for an email address before they let you in. Create an email address for the agent to use, and the messages those sites send — including sign-in links and verification codes — arrive in an inbox here that you can read. The address is backed by a standard Ethereum key held only on this device.
agentEmail.error: Could not set up the agent email
agentEmail.addressFooter: Messages sent to this address arrive in the agent's inbox on this device.
agentEmail.useAutomaticallyHint: When a site asks for an email while signing in, offer to fill in this address. You still submit the form and confirm any verification yourself.
agentEmail.removeConfirm: The seed phrase is deleted from this device. Without a backup of it you cannot restore this email or read its past messages.

restore.title: Restore Email
restore.hint: Enter the 12-word seed phrase of an agent email to restore its address on this device.
restore.invalid: That is not a valid 12-word seed phrase.

seed.title: Your seed phrase
seed.warning: Write these words down and keep them somewhere safe. They are the only way to restore this email, and anyone who has them can read its mail. Never share them.
seed.missing: No seed phrase is stored on this device.

passwords.empty: No saved passwords yet. Logins you fill with the agent email appear here, and you can add your own.
passwords.saveError: Could not save. Check the website, email and password.
passwords.removeConfirm: The email and password for this site are deleted from this device.

apiKeys.title: API Keys
apiKeys.cloudDescription: raidr runs your request. No key needed.
apiKeys.localDescription: Your request is planned by your chosen AI provider using your own key. Site sign-ins stay on this device.
apiKeys.localDisabled: Save a key for at least one provider below to turn on Local.
apiKeys.orderNote: The top provider with a saved key is used; the others are fallbacks, tried in order. Drag the handle to reorder.
apiKeys.storageNote: Keys are kept in this device's secure storage and only shown masked.
apiKeys.removeMessage: Your {{provider}} key will be deleted from this device.
